problem_keywords: Echo in auditoriums, cinemas, and music rooms
ugly silver foil or yellow glasswool visible behind slotted timber or perforated metal ceiling/wall screens.
not_for: not_for): Not a stand-alone decorative wall panel in touch zones (use Quietspace Panel or Cube for exposed touch areas).
use_cases: When client has slotted timber or perforated metal panels, specify Black AAB (32kg/m³ or 48kg/m³). It conceals wall framing studs, provides deep black shadow lines, and delivers up to NRC 1.05 sound absorption.
